title: Day 103: Mexico-FIFA Final Security Review; OCCRP Exposes CJNG Algorithm Warfare; World Cup T-6 Days; El Sapo at Large Day 103
detail: Day 103 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). MEXICO-FIFA FINAL PRE-TOURNAMENT SECURITY REVIEW (June 5, 2026): Mexican security authorities met with FIFA officials in a final pre-tournament security assessment, confirmed by ESPN. The review evaluated Plan Kukulkan's readiness for the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match in 6 days (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). Guadalajara — site of four group-stage matches (beginning June 15) and CJNG's historic operational center — remained the primary cartel-risk focal point of the security review. The meeting comes with Mexico's 99,000+ security personnel at peak deployment. Mexican officials indicated all security systems are operational and the security plan is proceeding as planned. OCCRP — CJNG WEAPONIZED ALGORITHMS INVESTIGATION (June 2026): The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP) published a major investigative feature — 'Fear Is the Message: How the Jalisco New Generation Cartel Weaponized Algorithms to Paralyze Mexico' — documenting how CJNG systematically weaponized social media algorithms as a force-multiplication tool. The investigation reveals that CJNG deployed coordinated viral campaigns of cartel violence videos on social media platforms, deliberately triggering algorithmic amplification to spread psychological terror — paralyzing Mexican businesses, local governments, and civil society without requiring additional gunmen. The investigation positions CJNG's information warfare doctrine as the structural mechanism behind the 'narcobloqueo effect': local populations immobilized by social media saturation of cartel violence before physical force even arrives. The OCCRP findings are significant because they document CJNG's capacity to project territorial control at scale during the post-Mencho succession period — even as the cartel's leadership tier has been decapitated. PLAN KUKULKAN — T-6 DAYS: Six days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match. Mexico's deployment at peak operational level: 20,000 Armed Forces (SEDENA, SEMAR), 55,000 federal and state police, 188 canine units, 2,100 military vehicles, 24 aircraft/anti-drone systems. Anti-drone systems fully operational at Estadio Azteca (Mexico City), Estadio Akron (Guadalajara), and Estadio BBVA (Monterrey). CJNG CARTEL BLACKOUT — CONFIRMED ONGOING: Available intelligence confirms CJNG's internal operational directive to avoid high-visibility violence during the World Cup tournament window remains in effect. Analysts assess this as temporary operational calculus. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 103: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target on Day 103. The pre-June 11 capture objective has passed the feasible operational window; Mexico's security posture has pivoted to World Cup perimeter protection. El Sapo continues commanding CJNG's military operations from an undisclosed location. CJNG COLOMBIAN MERCENARIES — PURÉPECHA PLATEAU (Ongoing): 60+ Colombian paramilitary operatives continue operating across 10 Michoacán municipalities. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 27: No confirmed successor plaza boss at the Port of Manzanillo. CJNG JUNE ATTACK SURGE — ONGOING: June 2026 remains the highest-attack month of the post-Mencho period. JUNE BILATERAL MULLIN MEETING: Not yet calendared despite being confirmed as scheduled. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION: Ongoing — two lines (federal jurisdiction invasion + possible treason). SUCCESSION BINARY (Day 103): El 03 (confirmed leader, financial wing, Grupo Élite) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 103: 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized since Feb 22.
